title: Stock Market Today, Aug. 6: SoundHound AI Surges 10% on Record Q2 Revenue and Raised 2026 Guidance
excerpt: On Aug. 6, 2026, the voice AI platform posted $61.9M quarterly revenue and extended its post-earnings rally on expanded partnerships across multiple sectors.
content_html:
Josh Kohn-Lindquist, The Motley Fool

Thu, August 6, 2026 at 6:41 PM EDT 3 min read

SoundHound AI (NASDAQ:SOUN), a voice AI platform for enterprise and automotive conversational experiences, closed at $7.08, up 10.11%. The stock surged after record quarterly revenue, a smaller-than-expected loss, and raised full-year guidance; investors are watching management commentary on revenue, margins, and the LivePerson acquisition. Trading volume reached 88.0M shares, coming in about 187% above its three-month average of 30.7M shares. SoundHound AI IPO'd in 2022 and has fallen 6% since going public.

How the markets moved today

The S&P 500 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC) fell 0.16% to 7,711, and the Nasdaq Composite (NASDAQINDEX:^IXIC) slipped 0.06% to 26,348. Among conversational AI software and voice technology peers, Cerence (NASDAQ:CRNC) closed at $9.02, down 2.17%, while SoundHound AI outperformed sector rivals during Thursday's session.

What this means for investors

It was a good day for SoundHound AI investors as the stock blew past analysts' expectations for the second quarter. Sales rose 45% in Q2, and the company's adjusted net income margin improved from -28% to -15%, as margins continued to improve quickly. Management also raised sales guidance to $245 million at the midpoint for 2026, excluding the potential closing of its LivePerson acquisition, which would, if closed, expand its omnichannel messaging capabilities.

While SoundHound still needs to rein in stock-based compensation (SBC) over time — SBC still equals a whopping 45% of sales — the company continues to land new contracts across a wide array of customer verticals, including financial services, restaurants, healthcare, telecos, retail, and, of course, autos. Trading at roughly 11 times forward sales, SoundHound isn't outrageously priced if it can continue to experience the hyper-growth it has seen over the last five years and keep improving its margins steadily.

That said, SoundHound will remain a volatile option for investors, and it is yet to be determined just how wide a moat the company has, if any, so interested investors should buy in small batches over time, rather than going "all-in" today.

Should you buy stock in SoundHound AI right now?

SoundHound AI（纳斯达克股票代码：SOUN）是一个面向企业和汽车对话体验的语音人工智能平台，收盘价为 7.08 美元，上涨 10.11%。 该股在创纪录的季度收入、小于预期的亏损以及上调全年指引后飙升；投资者正在关注管理层对收入、利润率和 LivePerson 收购的评论。 交易量达到 8800 万股，比三个月平均水平 3070 万股高出约 187%。 SoundHound AI 于 2022 年首次公开募股，自上市以来已下跌 6%。

今日市场走势如何

标准普尔 500 指数 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC) 下跌 0.16%，至 7,711 点；纳斯达克综合指数 (NASDAQINDEX:^IXIC) 下跌 0.06%，至 26,348 点。 在对话式人工智能软件和语音技术同行中，Cerence (纳斯达克股票代码：CRNC) 收于 9.02 美元，下跌 2.17%，而 SoundHound AI 在周四的交易中表现优于行业竞争对手。

这对投资者意味着什么

对于 SoundHound AI 投资者来说，这是美好的一天，因为该股第二季度的表现超出了分析师的预期。 第二季度销售额增长 45%，随着利润率持续快速改善，公司调整后净利润率从 -28% 提高至 -15%。 管理层还将 2026 年中点的销售指引提高至 2.45 亿美元，不包括可能完成的 LivePerson 收购，如果收购完成，将扩大其全渠道消息传递能力。

虽然 SoundHound 仍需要随着时间的推移控制股票薪酬 (SBC)——SBC 仍占销售额的 45%，但该公司继续在广泛的客户垂直领域签订新合同，包括金融服务、餐馆、医疗保健、电信、零售，当然还有汽车。 SoundHound 的交易价格约为预期销售额的 11 倍，如果它能够继续经历过去五年的高速增长并持续稳步提高利润率，那么它的定价并不算离谱。

也就是说，SoundHound 对于投资者来说仍然是一个不稳定的选择，而且该公司的护城河有多宽（如果有的话）还有待确定，因此感兴趣的投资者应该随着时间的推移小批量购买，而不是今天“全押”。
